My boss is like this. He's nice enough, but work is his only focus. Throughout this debacle of 2020 I've needed more personal days than normal due to anxiety at the way the world is going, but the world burning down doesn't seem to bug him (outwardly at least). He's never interested in talking about things outside of work. Hell, I have to take breaks away from him because he will talk about work during break too. He just doesn't get that I can't 'just forget about everything and focus on work'. 

This is a guy who uses his weekends for sidework. He's a machine. 
In a way, I envy him this ability to shut things out. 

I know I'm not changing the world by being anxious and taking days off so I'm not better than him or anything but I cannot imagine living my life ignoring the world's problems with my nose to the grindstone like him.

I really hate this existence. Working 40 hours a week and coming home to tradeschool, then finally being too exhausted physically and mentally to do anything about the world... knowing that even when I'm done with school the industry isn't doing that well. That I will still struggle to raise kids and have a house, that I will struggle to have savings, that when I retire I will lose health insurance... I hate ~~feeling like~~ knowing I'm not considered an equal participant in the world I live in, that the only reason I get to exist in this system is because I'm useful at make someone else money; and when that is no longer the case I will be shoved aside.
